messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: Alternative specific variable - multinomial logit
parts:
A special case of the multinomial logit model, where the response is one (and only one) of a certain category, is implemented via family "categorical".

Modelling a response that is multinomially distributed in the general sense, is not yet possible in brms.

Feel free to open an issue for it on the github page of brms, explaining the model more specifically that you have in mind. That way I don't loose track of it.
